notes.title: Update 2
notes.notes:
Just a small update with bug fixes, there will be a large content update later this week:

- Fixed deleting items bugs
- Improved pathfinding
- Added Chips
- Layed down framework for new content
- General bug fixes

For more info on development of Supermarket Tycoon & Sneak Thief follow @sneakthiefgame on twitter

notes.title: Update 1 - Launch Fixes
notes.notes:
This update is basically addressing most of the bugs and complaints about the game on launch day that I previously paid no mind to or did not notice,

- Zooming in and out added
- Customers no longer spawn if your store is empty
- Added basic settings menu for graphics and audio in game
- Fixed basic bugs
- Improved Anti-Aliasing 
- General Improvements to AI
